subject: EU VAT: invoice bucket mapping + suspense routing after billing cutover
messages:
From: Sophie Lemaire <sophie@novacloud.fr>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Etienne Dubois <etienne@novacloud.fr>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: VAT treatment for cutover invoices & suspense balances

Hi Marissa,

Following our EU billing cutover last week, our finance team is seeing invoice lines allocated to two different 'billing buckets' (monthly vs ad-hoc) which has caused a ~€31k suspense balance on your AR for August. Several invoices show VAT at 20% and others at 0% depending on the bucket — we're concerned this will misstate VAT payable and AR aging on our side.

Can you confirm how Redwood mapped the old subscription invoices to the new billing buckets and whether any automatic VAT-code remapping was applied at cutover? We've attached a short extract of transactions (CSV) and a sample remittance showing the mismatch.

We'd like to avoid manual re-billing if possible; please let us know the mapping logic and whether a journal correction on Redwood's ledger is required.

Thanks,
Sophie
Finance Operations
NovaCloud

Attachments: novacloud-remit-samples.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lemaire <sophie@novacloud.fr>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for cutover invoices & suspense balances

Hi Sophie — thanks for the examples and the heads-up. We're actively triaging this. High-level notes: 

- The cutover created two invoice routing paths: "legacy-subscriptions" (monthly bucket) and "ad-hoc" (one-off usage/credits). During migration we applied a mapping that preserved VAT codes from the incoming customer record, but we discovered a rule that forces EU VAT = 0% for invoices flagged as "ad-hoc" if no VAT reg number is present.

- That rule looks like it captured some subscription invoices incorrectly because the cutover flags were inconsistent for a subset of accounts.

Action items I propose:
1) I'll attach an internal AR mapping sheet (ar-mapping-sheet.xlsx) with a candidate mapping and proposed journal adjustments to clear suspense into correct AR buckets.
2) Grace, can you validate the VAT code assignment logic and confirm whether we can safely backfill VAT for the affected invoice set?
3) Ben, please prepare the JV file for accounting to post (journal-adjustment-jv3412.csv) if we confirm manual adjustments are required.

Sophie — could you share the remittance file for the full August run (we only have samples)? That will let us reconcile unapplied payments.

I'll follow up with a short reconciliation report by EOD Monday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: ar-mapping-sheet.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophie Lemaire <sophie@novacloud.fr>
Date: 2026-09-04T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for cutover invoices & suspense balances

Thanks Marissa — I reviewed the mapping rules. Quick observations: 

- The "ad-hoc -> 0% VAT when no VAT reg" rule was intended for marketplace-style one-offs; it shouldn't have been applied to subscription records. There's a mismatch in the customer metadata flag at cutover for ~18 invoices for Novacloud.
- We can safely backfill VAT on those invoices if Novacloud can confirm their VAT reg number for the affected entities (we need the exact legal entity).

Questions for NOVACLOUD:
- Can you confirm the legal entity and VAT registration number for the invoices dated 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-31?

Proposal: Once we have that, accounting will:
A) Post JV to move amounts from "AR - suspense (cutover)" to "AR - subscriptions", with VAT coded at 20% where applicable.
B) Notify tax to include the corrected VAT in the next EU VAT return.

Ben, I'll hand the JV specs to you once Sophie confirms entity details.

- Grace
Senior Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lemaire <sophie@novacloud.fr>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Etienne Dubois <etienne@novacloud.fr>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:20:00Z
Subject: Summary & request: Novacloud entity details for VAT backfill

Hi Sophie / Etienne — following up with next steps. We've attached a short reconciliation workbook that links invoice IDs to the proposed AR buckets and the suspense lines. Next steps below: 

1) Please confirm the legal entity name(s) and VAT registration numbers for the rows highlighted in the attached workbook. We need the exact text that should appear on tax filings.
2) If you can provide the full August remittance (or a full payments extract), upload to the Drive folder (link below) or reply with the file so we can match unapplied payments.
3) Expected impact: if the VAT reg is confirmed, we estimate ~€31,278 will be moved from suspense to subscriptions and VAT payable will increase by ~€5,213 for the period. We'll prepare JV3412 for posting and notify tax.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-novacloud-ar-cutover
HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/Novacloud

If you'd prefer a short call to walk through the rows, I'm available tomorrow 10:00-12:00 CEST.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: ar-mapping-sheet.xlsx (updated)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophie Lemaire <sophie@novacloud.fr>, Etienne Dubois <etienne@novacloud.fr>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for cutover invoices & suspense balances — JV and posting plan

All — quick update after validating the mapping and prepping the JV: 

- I generated the journal (journal-adjustment-jv3412.csv) to move the €31,278 from "AR - suspense (cutover)" to "AR - subscriptions" and to post the associated VAT lines. The CSV includes per-invoice references for audit trail.
- Tax has been looped in and will include the correction in the September EU return; they asked us to hold posting until Novacloud confirms entity/VAT numbers (audit control).
- Next steps for Novacloud: confirm VAT reg numbers for the highlighted invoices or confirm if they want credit notes issued instead.

Sophie / Etienne — once you confirm, we'll schedule the JV posting (we can do it this week) and I'll send a short reconciliation pack showing pre/post GL positions.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior AR Analyst | Redwood Inference

Attachments: journal-adjustment-jv3412.csv (csv)
